Title: Computational Scientist and Bioinformatician
Description:
IFOM is an internationally recognized non-profit cancer research institute supported by the Italian Association for Cancer Research (AIRC), based in Milan within a highly dynamic urban environment.

IFOM's continued success is ensured by the recruitment of highly selected undergraduate, graduate and post-graduate researchers from over 24 countries worldwide.

IFOM is hosted within a research campus shared with the European Institute of Oncology and the Italian Institute of Technology.

IFOM is committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment, based on mutual respect and the enhancement of diversity, offering equal job opportunities to all qualified candidates.




We seek for our Institute: Computational Scientist and Bioinformatician




The successful candidate will join the Computational Oncology and Bioinformatics Unit and report directly to the Head of the Unit. This is a permanent, full-time position with a central role in delivering bioinformatics and computational analyses across strategically relevant institutional, translational and collaborative research programmes at IFOM.

The Unit coordinates bioinformatics and computational medicine activities, promotes the development of advanced analytical platforms, integrates molecular and clinical data, and implements innovative research projects in collaboration with IFOM research groups and external clinical, academic and industrial partners.

The Unit operates as a research and development structure rather than a task-based facility. The candidate will therefore contribute as an integrated scientific partner throughout the research process, from study design and analytical planning to biological interpretation, dissemination and publication.

The Unit aims to generate clinically relevant knowledge and novel therapeutic opportunities by:

integrating genomic, transcriptomic and other molecular data with clinical and phenotypic information;
characterizing tumour evolution, heterogeneity, cellular plasticity, treatment response and resistance;
developing and validating computational methods and reproducible analytical platforms for tissue- and liquid-biopsy studies;
supporting high-priority institutional programmes and collaborative projects with robust, innovative and quantitatively sound analyses.

We are looking for a scientist with at least 3 years of relevant experience in bioinformatics, computational biology or biomedical data science, including doctoral research where applicable.

The candidate will be responsible for:

Designing, implementing and interpreting bioinformatics analyses of next-generation sequencing and multi-omic datasets, including WES/WGS, targeted sequencing, RNA sequencing and liquid-biopsy data.
Developing, validating and maintaining reproducible analytical pipelines, standard operating procedures and documentation, with appropriate QA/QC, version control and testing.
Integrating molecular data with clinical and experimental variables to generate biologically and clinically meaningful results.
Contributing to study design, analytical strategy, statistical planning and the definition of computational endpoints for preclinical, translational and clinical research projects.
Working closely with wet-lab scientists, clinicians, computational researchers and external partners to translate scientific questions into effective analytical solutions.




About the position

Coordinating computational activities across multiple projects, managing priorities, milestones, deliverables and dependencies in agreement with the Head of the Unit.
Communicating analytical approaches and results clearly through technical reports, project meetings, presentations, manuscripts, grant applications and institutional deliverables.
Contributing to the management, optimization and responsible use of servers, HPC resources and data storage in coordination with IFOM IT, RCDS unit and infrastructure teams.
Ensuring secure and compliant handling of research and clinical data in accordance with institutional data-governance policies, GDPR requirements and research ethics.
Providing technical guidance and contributing to the training and mentoring of junior researchers and students.
Developing independent methodological contributions and actively supporting the scientific growth and visibility of the Unit.




Qualification

Strong background in cancer biology and/or computational sciences, with demonstrated experience in translational, biomedical or clinically oriented research contexts.
Solid knowledge of statistics, quantitative methods and sound principles of experimental and observational data analysis.
Demonstrated experience in the analysis of NGS and/or multi-omic data and in the biological interpretation of complex datasets.
Programming skills in Bash, Python and/or R; experience with C, C++ or comparable languages is considered an advantage.
High confidence in Linux-based systems and command-line environments.
Experience with computational infrastructures, including servers and/or HPC environments, job schedulers, resource management and storage systems.
Experience with reproducible research practices, including workflow automation, version control, code documentation, software testing and containerized environments.
Basic to intermediate knowledge of IT infrastructure and information-security best practices, including user and access management, data protection, backup principles and compliance with data-governance policies.
Proven ability to manage computational analyses across multiple projects, exercise independent scientific judgement and take ownership of technical deliverables.
Ability to communicate analytical choices and results clearly and to work constructively within multidisciplinary teams spanning biology, computation and clinical research.
Flexible, reliable and problem-solving-oriented approach, with the ability to adapt to evolving scientific and project requirements.
Experience with LLM is a plus.




Education

Candidates with a PhD in biology or another life-science discipline will also be considered when supported by a strong and demonstrable computational profile. PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, computer science, applied mathematics, statistics or biostatistics, data science, computer or biomedical engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.




Languages

Professional proficiency in spoken and written English, sufficient to work effectively in an international scientific environment and communicate technical results.
Experience with C, C++ or comparable languages is considered an advantage.
Knowledge of Italian is not required but will be considered an advantage.




Soft skills

Scientific curiosity and a rigorous, solution-oriented mindset.
Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to collaborative research.
Clear and pragmatic communication with colleagues from different scientific and professional backgrounds.
Strong organization, reliability, adaptability and attention to the quality and reproducibility of results.
The ideal candidate should be rigorous and uncompromising when it comes to data quality, while remaining respectful, constructive, and collaborative with colleagues.




What we offer

An international and highly collaborative research environment, continuous training and flexible working time.
Relocation-cost support and a guest house within the campus.
Support for candidates and their families, including housing, schooling, registration with the Italian National Health Service and work-permit procedures, through the IFOM Welcome Office.
Campus facilities and benefits, including a bar and canteen, lunch benefit, company nursery, medical service, laptop, CAF tax-declaration service and agreements with local gyms, pharmacies, psychological services and shops.
Access to Lab G, a laboratory specifically designed for pregnant or breastfeeding researchers.




Contract

Permanent contract, full time.




Location

Milan - Scalo di Porta Romana area




Contact Details

If you are interested in this opportunity, please submit your CV and a letter of interest to recruitment(at)ifom.eu and giovanni.crisafulli(at)ifom.eu.

Title: Deep AI native software engineer
Description:
YOU ARE

As an AI/ML Computational Scientist, you will design, build, and operationalize artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for enterprise clients, combining custom models with cloud and third-party AI services to deliver production-ready outcomes. Your role spans the full solution lifecycle — assessing client needs and data, selecting and customizing models (including Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models), designing scalable data and DevOps & MLOps pipelines for training and production, and ensuring quality, value, and reliability of deployed systems.

THE WORK



Formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions

Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, models, and computational systems; design and build scalable data pipelines to support model training and production with DevOps & MLOps

Customize and apply Deep Learning and Gen AI models for various use cases based on the business needs, data availability, system and infrastructure requirements - including edge device and HPC

Engage in research and development of new AI and high-performance compute algorithms, models, and simulations along with their applications to solve complex business problems at client sites

Work with large-scale datasets and utilize data preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality input for training and production

Implement and maintain efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms for models and knowledge using appropriate tools

Justify the value of model approaches in business problems

Collaborate with teams from both business and technical sides, including users, use case representatives, business owners, engineers, architects, and UI designers, to achieve end-to-end project goals and integrate into production



EDUCATION





Bachelor's Degree or equivalent



Basic (required) Qualification



Proven experience as a machine learning engineer or scientist, deploying models in production at scale , including monitoring, alerting, automatic bug filing and auditing.

Experience in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming

Hands-on experience in distributed computing systems and architecture that may include big data, high-performance compute, engineering simulations, scientific compute, grid and cloud computing, distributed networks

Experience in building and deploying AI/ML based software to a cloud environment.



Preferred Qualification



Proficiency in Python and python-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)..

Experience working with language models like LLM's APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications.

Experience with the following programming languages: Python, C++, Java, R, SQL

Strong written & verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

Strong client-facing skillsets in a consulting environment

Strong cross-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client-side teams

Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation

MS or PhD in related field preferred (computer science, engineering, etc.)



Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to role, level, seniority, responsibility, skillset, and level of experience. B2- €32,000 - €50,500

B3- €36,000 - €65,800

Title: Forward Deployed Engineer
Description:
We are expanding Duferco’s Corporate Innovation Team: a fast-moving team operating in a startup-like environment, backed by the stability and scale of a global diversified group.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer: someone who works close to business teams, understands messy operational problems, and turns AI, data, and automation into practical solutions.

You will work across domains such as energy, trading, logistics, steel, insurance, sports, and other sectors — not as an external consultant, but as part of the group itself, with the ownership and continuity of an internal product and engineering team.

You will identify opportunities, prototype AI-enabled tools, evaluate impact, and help deploy solutions that remove bottlenecks, improve decision-making, and create leverage across the business.




About the Team

We sit close to real business problems and have the freedom to prototype and ship quickly. AI is already part of our daily workflow, and we expect that role to keep expanding.

We care about building things that work in the real world: useful tools, reliable automations, better workflows, and systems that create measurable impact.

We appreciate people who enjoy ownership, fast iteration, pragmatic problem solving, and working directly with users to understand how things actually get done.




What You’ll Do

Design and build AI-enabled solutions that make the organization faster and smarter:

AI applications, agents, and automation workflows for real business processes
Data analysis, decision-support tools, and internal analytics workflows
Retrieval, document intelligence, structured outputs, and knowledge systems
Prototypes that test whether AI can create real operational value
Integrations with internal tools, databases, APIs, documents, and third-party systems
Evaluation and monitoring approaches to understand whether AI systems are working as intended




You’ll work directly with business and technical teams to understand problems, identify opportunities, prototype solutions, measure impact, and iterate — not just execute predefined specs.




What We Offer

A high-autonomy role with direct influence on how AI is applied across the group
Real business problems with visible impact
Modern AI-assisted tools and time to explore new technologies and approaches
A fast-moving, collaborative environment with talented and ambitious people
A broad variety of technical and business challenges across different domains
Competitive compensation and benefits
Flexible working hours and hybrid work setup.




You’re Probably a Fit If

You have hands-on experience applying AI, machine learning, data science, or analytics to real business problems.
You enjoy working close to users and business teams, understanding how work actually happens, and turning messy problems into useful AI-enabled solutions.
You are comfortable working with LLMs, modern AI APIs, structured and unstructured data, and know how to evaluate whether an AI solution is actually useful.
You can explore a dataset, identify patterns or opportunities, prototype a solution, and communicate trade-offs clearly.
You are pragmatic about AI: excited by what it can do, but aware of its limitations, failure modes, and the importance of good evaluation.
You have enough software engineering ability to build reliable prototypes, integrations, automations, or internal tools, preferably using Python.




Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, agent frameworks, workflow automation, forecasting, optimization, BI tools, Postgres, AWS, or complex operational domains is a strong plus.

You do not need experience with every technology we use. Curiosity, analytical thinking, adaptability, and the ability to turn AI into practical business impact matter much more.

If this sounds like the right fit for you, we’d love to hear from you.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About XTEL

XTEL is a leading global revenue management solutions provider for consumer goods companies (CPG). We help our clients' businesses grow smarter, every day, through our holistic and proven digitalisation and change management approach. By combining state-of-the-art technology, deep industry expertise, and a proven approach to data and change management, XTEL's Revenue Management suite supports CPGs towards value realisation and profitable revenue growth.




Position Overview

The Data Scientist supports the design and delivery of analytics and machine learning solutions by working with complex datasets, building tailored models, and contributing to scalable data pipelines. The role collaborates closely with technical, functional, product, and client stakeholders to develop robust solutions and help standardize analytics practices across projects.




Key Responsibilities

Analyze and preprocess complex data sets from various sources to prepare them for analytics solutions.
Develop, implement, and fine-tune machine learning models tailored to specific project needs.
Collaborate with the team to build robust and scalable data pipelines.
Participate in client meetings to discuss technical results and gather feedback.
Work together with the functional team involved in the project, including business experts and the project manager.
Provide technical support and mentorship to junior team members, promoting knowledge sharing within the team.
Work together with the product team to integrate developed solutions into our products.
Document processes and contribute to the standardization of analytics solutions.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in STEM fields, such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related disciplines.
3-6 years of work experience in Data Science and Analytics.
Knowledge for Data Science, including Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Operations Research.
Strong knowledge of Python and main Machine Learning frameworks, such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with object-oriented programming.
Practical experience in developing, validating, and tuning Machine Learning models.
Experience with cloud services to store data, build automated pipelines, and run analytics or machine learning solutions.
Experience with Databricks.
Familiarity with development tools such as VSCode or other IDEs, and Jupyter notebooks.
Knowledge of Git, including push, pull, fetch, and merge.
Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and communicate complex results clearly.
Strong analytical skills with a critical thinking attitude.
Proficient in English.

Nice to have:

CPG / FMCG industry knowledge is an advantage.
Experience with SQL for data manipulation and analysis.




Geographical Location:

Belgium (Leuven — Hybrid)
Hybrid work arrangements

A challenging role in a fast-growing AI-driven company; 🪄

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist – Advanced Analytics | Retail Industry




We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join an Advanced Analytics team within the retail industry.

You will work on high-impact data and AI initiatives across e-commerce, marketing, customer experience, stores, product, supply chain, and procurement. The role combines traditional Data Science with Generative AI, AI Agents, and MLOps, offering the opportunity to contribute to an ambitious digital retail strategy.




Your Responsibilities




Data Science & Machine Learning

Analyze large and complex datasets using advanced statistical and machine learning techniques.
Identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights to support business decision-making.
Design, build, and deploy predictive and prescriptive ML models.
Develop solutions leveraging Generative AI and AI Agents.
Continuously optimize, fine-tune, and improve model performance.




MLOps & Production

Apply MLOps best practices throughout the machine learning lifecycle.
Implement model versioning, CI/CD, and automated deployment.
Monitor model performance and establish retraining and maintenance processes.
Ensure models are scalable, reliable, and production-ready.




Collaboration & Business Impact

Work closely with data platform teams, data insights teams, and business stakeholders.
Translate business challenges into effective data-driven solutions.
Communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Title: Data scientist
Description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Hoe maak jij mee het verschil?

Als Data Scientist – in de Corporate strategy dienst – ontwikkel en onderhoud je strategische modellen die diepgaande inzichten opleveren en direct bijdragen aan beleidskeuzes en investeringsbeslissingen.

Je werkt op het kruispunt van data, business en strategie en zorgt ervoor dat complexe assumpties en berekeningen transparant, robuust en reproduceerbaar worden geïmplementeerd in schaalbare data-oplossingen.

Je komt terecht in een agile team waar PySpark centraal staat voor de ontwikkeling van dataoplossingen. Daarbij werken we met Azure Databricks, Azure DevOps en VS Code. Samenwerking, kennisdeling en kwaliteit staan centraal.

Wat is jouw rol bij NMBS?

Als Data Scientist Heb Je De Volgende Verantwoordelijkheden


Je ontwikkelt, onderhoudt en industrialiseert strategische modellen op basis van businessassumpties, in samenwerking met de relevante stakeholders.
Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende NMBS-directies in een transversale context over de hele organisatie.
Je vertaalt bestaande modellen, die vandaag lokaal beheerd worden, naar robuuste en schaalbare PySpark-oplossingen.
Je automatiseert dataverwerking en modelruns via pipelines in Databricks.
Je werkt met Python en PySpark binnen een Azure Databricks-omgeving om data te verwerken, modellen te implementeren en analyses uit te voeren.
Je waakt over transparantie, reproduceerbaarheid en best practices bij het implementeren van modellen.
Je verkent opportuniteiten om bijkomende databronnen en analysetechnieken (zoals ruimtelijke data, AI of geavanceerde visualisaties) te integreren wanneer deze een duidelijke meerwaarde bieden voor strategische inzichten.
Je volgt de AI en machine learning evoluties actief op en denkt mee na over hoe ze het strategisch modelleren kunnen versterken.


Waarom is deze job iets voor jou?


Je beschikt over een masterdiploma bij voorkeur in wiskunde, statistiek, data science, ingenieurswetenschappen of een andere kwantitatieve richting) (of gelijkwaardig door ervaring) EN een ervaring van minstens 4 jaar ervaring in de industrie als data scientist.


EN Je Beschikt Over De Volgende Vaardigheden


Je hebt een sterke Python-kennis voor data wrangling data-analyse en modellering.
Je hebt een goede en aantoonbare kennis van PySpark en het werken met grotere datasets. PySpark is een kerncompetentie voor deze functie.
Je hebt ervaring met het industrialiseren van analyses of modellen.
Je kan autonoom werken, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je opdrachten en weet zelfstandig tot oplossing te komen, met de nodige afstemming binnen het team.
Je communiceert vlot, zowel in het Nederlands als in het Engels en je kan complexe modellen en assumpties helder toelichten aan niet-technische stakeholders.
Je hebt een gestructureerde mindset en bent oplossings- en kwaliteitsgericht.
Heb je interesse in machine learning, AI-toepassingen, geografische data of GIS-tools, transport, mobiliteit of complexe operationele systemen? Die zijn extra troeven.


Indien je jouw diploma in het buitenland hebt behaald, dien je in het bezit te zijn van een gelijkwaardigheidsattest afgeleverd door de Vlaamse Overheid (NARIC-Vlaanderen) om deel te kunnen nemen aan de selectie.

We vinden het dan ook belangrijk dat je jezelf kan zijn. Want dat maakt NMBS sterker. Daarom hechten we veel belang aan diversiteit en inclusie.

Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

Kiezen Voor NMBS Is Kiezen Voor Een Omgeving Waarin Je Kan Bijleren En Groeien. Je Wordt Gesteund En Omringd Door Fijne Collega's. Als Data Scientist Krijg Je Een Loonpakket Dat Bestaat Uit


Een aantrekkelijk salaris aangevuld met een 13e maand, onkostenvergoeding, maaltijdcheques en een collectieve en individuele bonus.
Een deel van het salaris wordt aangeboden als een flexibel budget. Je kan daarbij kiezen voor fietslease, lease auto, terugbetaling pensioensparen, ...
Een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Flexibele werkuren, de mogelijkheid om te telewerken en 33 vakantiedagen per jaar.
Een treinabonnement in België, kortingen op internationale treinreizen en een fietsvergoeding.
Voordelen voor je gezin: o.a. kortingen op gezinsactiviteiten en in winkelketens.


Waar ga je werken?

Je werkt in de buurt van het station Brussel-Zuid, in het gebouw Delta.

What’s next?


Je solliciteert online en je voegt een motivatiebrief toe. Beschrijf daarin kort je professionele ervaring met PySpark: hoeveel jaar ervaring je hebt, hoe recent je ermee hebt gewerkt en in welke context. Vermeld ook je ervaring met Databricks of vergelijkbare platformen. Vertel tot slot waarom deze functie je aanspreekt.
We screenen je CV en motivatiebrief. Bij een positieve screening volgt een HR-gesprek om je motivatie en match met NMBS te bespreken. We stellen ook enkele technische verkennende vragen.
Verloopt dit positief? Je ontvangt een technische opdracht die besproken wordt in een tweede gesprek. Ter voorbereiding op dit gesprek vragen we jou om een online persoonlijkheidsvragenlijst in te vullen.
Op basis van de volledige selectieprocedure kiezen we de best passende kandidaat. Daarna volgt een kennismaking met de Head of Corporate Strategy en de betrokken leidinggevende.
Verloopt deze laatste kennismaking goed? Er volgt dan een contractvoorstel.
Je bent klaar voor je eerste werkdag!


Wij behouden ons het recht om deze procedure aan te passen of op te schorten indien nodig. Ons rekruteringsteam zal de profielen selecteren die het best aansluiten bij de functie-eisen om een optimale match te garanderen.

Title: Data scientist _FR
Description:
Comment pouvez-vous faire la différence ?

En tant que Data scientist – dans le service Corporate strategy, vous développez et maintenez des modèles stratégiques qui fournissent des insights approfondis et qui contribuent directement aux choix politiques et aux décisions d’investissement.

Vous travaillez à l’intersection des données, du business et de la stratégie et vous veillez à ce que des hypothèses et calculs complexes soient implémentés de manière transparente, robuste et reproductible dans des solutions de données évolutives.

Vous intégrez une équipe agile où PySpark occupe une place centrale dans le développement de solutions data. Nous travaillons avec Azure Databricks, Azure DevOps et VS Code. La collaboration, le partage de connaissance et la qualité sont essentiels.

Quel est votre rôle à la SNCB ?

En tant que Data scientist, vous aurez les responsabilités suivantes :


Vous développez, maintenez et industrialisez des modèles stratégiques sur la base d’hypothèses métier, en collaboration avec les parties prenantes concernées.
Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec des collègues de différentes directions de la SNCB dans un contexte transversal à l’échelle de toute l’organisation.
Vous traduisez des modèles existants, aujourd’hui gérés localement, en solutions PySpark robustes et évolutives.
Vous automatisez le traitement des données et l’exécution des modèles via des pipelines dans Databricks.
Vous travaillez avec Python et PySpark dans un environnement Azure Databricks pour traiter les données, implémenter des modèles et réaliser des analyses.
Vous veillez à la transparence, à la reproductibilité et au respect des bonnes pratiques lors de l’implémentation des modèles.
Vous explorez les opportunités d’intégrer des sources de données et des techniques analytiques supplémentaires (telles que les données spatiales, l’IA ou des visualisations avancées) lorsqu’elles apportent une réelle valeur ajoutée aux insights stratégiques.
Vous suivez activement les évolutions IA et machine learning et réfléchissez à la manière dont elles peuvent renforcer la modélisation stratégique.


Un job fait pour vous ?


Vous avez un master, de préférence en mathématiques, statistiques, data science, sciences de l’ingénieur ou une autre discipline quantitative (ou équivalent par expérience) ET une expérience de minimum 4 ans en tant que data scientist en industrie.


ET vous disposez des compétences suivantes :


Vous êtes doté.e d’une solide connaissance de Python pour le data wrangling, l’analyse de données et la modélisation.
Vous avez de l’expérience avec PySpark et le travail avec de grands volumes de données.
Vous avez de l’expérience dans l’industrialisation d’analyses ou de modèles (par exemple la migration d’Excel vers du code de production).
Vous communiquez aisément, aussi bien en français qu’en anglais et pouvez expliquer clairement des modèles complexes et des hypothèses à des parties prenantes non techniques.
Vous avez un esprit structuré et êtes orienté.e solution et qualité.
Vous avez un intérêt pour le machine learning, les applications d’IA, les données géographiques ou outils GIS (par ex. QGIS, ArcGIS), le transport, la mobilité ou des systèmes opérationnels complexes ? Il s’agit d’atouts en plus.


Si vous avez obtenu votre diplôme à l'étranger, vous devez être en possession d'une attestation d'équivalence délivrée par la Communauté française pour pouvoir participer à la sélection.

Chaque personne est unique. Il est important pour nous que vous puissiez être vous-même. C’est ce qui rend la SNCB plus forte. C’est pourquoi nous accordons beaucoup d’importance à la diversité et à l’inclusion .

Qu'avons-nous à vous offrir ?

Choisir la SNCB, c'est choisir un environnement où vous pouvez apprendre et vous épanouir. Vous serez entouré de chouettes collègues qui vous soutiendront. En tant que Data Scientist, vous recevez un package salarial qui se compose de :


Un salaire attractif complété d'un 13e mois, d'une indemnité de frais, des chèques-repas et d'un bonus collectif et individuel.
Une partie du salaire est offerte sous forme de budget flexible. Vous pouvez opter pour la location d'un vélo, une voiture en leasing, pour le remboursement de l'épargne-pension, etc.
Une assurance hospitalisation et collective.
Un horaire flexible, un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à 33 jours de congés par an.
Un abonnement de train en Belgique, des avantages sur les lignes internationales et une indemnité vélo.

Description:
Hoe maak jij mee het verschil?

Als Data Scientist – in de Corporate strategy dienst – ontwikkel en onderhoud je strategische modellen die diepgaande inzichten opleveren en direct bijdragen aan beleidskeuzes en investeringsbeslissingen.

Je werkt op het kruispunt van data, business en strategie en zorgt ervoor dat complexe assumpties en berekeningen transparant, robuust en reproduceerbaar worden geïmplementeerd in schaalbare data‑oplossingen.

Je komt terecht in een agile team waar PySpark centraal staat voor de ontwikkeling van dataoplossingen. Daarbij werken we met Azure Databricks, Azure DevOps en VS Code. Samenwerking, kennisdeling en kwaliteit staan centraal.

Wat is jouw rol bij NMBS?

Als Data Scientist heb je de volgende verantwoordelijkheden:


Je ontwikkelt, onderhoudt en industrialiseert strategische modellen op basis van businessassumpties, in samenwerking met de relevante stakeholders.
Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende NMBS-directies in een transversale context over de hele organisatie.
Je vertaalt bestaande modellen, die vandaag lokaal beheerd worden, naar robuuste en schaalbare PySpark‑oplossingen.
Je automatiseert dataverwerking en modelruns via pipelines in Databricks.
Je werkt met Python en PySpark binnen een Azure Databricks‑omgeving om data te verwerken, modellen te implementeren en analyses uit te voeren.
Je waakt over transparantie, reproduceerbaarheid en best practices bij het implementeren van modellen.
Je verkent opportuniteiten om bijkomende databronnen en analysetechnieken (zoals ruimtelijke data, AI of geavanceerde visualisaties) te integreren wanneer deze een duidelijke meerwaarde bieden voor strategische inzichten.
Je volgt de AI en machine learning evoluties actief op en denkt mee na over hoe ze het strategisch modelleren kunnen versterken.


Waarom is deze job iets voor jou?


Je beschikt over een masterdiploma bij voorkeur in wiskunde, statistiek, data science, ingenieurswetenschappen of een andere kwantitatieve richting) (of gelijkwaardig door ervaring) EN een ervaring van minstens 4 jaar ervaring in de industrie als data scientist.


EN je beschikt over de volgende vaardigheden:


Je hebt een sterke Python‑kennis voor data wrangling data‑analyse en modellering.
Je hebt een goede en aantoonbare kennis van PySpark en het werken met grotere datasets. PySpark is een kerncompetentie voor deze functie.
Je hebt ervaring met het industrialiseren van analyses of modellen.
Je kan autonoom werken, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je opdrachten en weet zelfstandig tot oplossing te komen, met de nodige afstemming binnen het team.
Je communiceert vlot, zowel in het Nederlands als in het Engels en je kan complexe modellen en assumpties helder toelichten aan niet‑technische stakeholders.
Je hebt een gestructureerde mindset en bent oplossings- en kwaliteitsgericht.
Heb je interesse in machine learning, AI-toepassingen, geografische data of GIS-tools, transport, mobiliteit of complexe operationele systemen? Die zijn extra troeven.


Indien je jouw diploma in het buitenland hebt behaald, dien je in het bezit te zijn van een gelijkwaardigheidsattest afgeleverd door de Vlaamse Overheid (NARIC-Vlaanderen) om deel te kunnen nemen aan de selectie.

We vinden het dan ook belangrijk dat je jezelf kan zijn. Want dat maakt NMBS sterker. Daarom hechten we veel belang aan diversiteit en inclusie .

Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

Kiezen voor NMBS is kiezen voor een omgeving waarin je kan bijleren en groeien. Je wordt gesteund en omringd door fijne collega's. Als Data Scientist krijg je een loonpakket dat bestaat uit:


Een aantrekkelijk salaris aangevuld met een 13e maand, onkostenvergoeding, maaltijdcheques en een collectieve en individuele bonus.
Een deel van het salaris wordt aangeboden als een flexibel budget. Je kan daarbij kiezen voor fietslease, lease auto, terugbetaling pensioensparen, ...
Een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Flexibele werkuren, de mogelijkheid om te telewerken en 33 vakantiedagen per jaar.
Een treinabonnement in België, kortingen op internationale treinreizen en een fietsvergoeding.
Voordelen voor je gezin: o.a. kortingen op gezinsactiviteiten en in winkelketens.


Waar ga je werken?

Je werkt in de buurt van het station Brussel-Zuid, in het gebouw Delta.

What’s next?


Je solliciteert online en je voegt een motivatiebrief toe. Beschrijf daarin kort je professionele ervaring met PySpark: hoeveel jaar ervaring je hebt, hoe recent je ermee hebt gewerkt en in welke context. Vermeld ook je ervaring met Databricks of vergelijkbare platformen. Vertel tot slot waarom deze functie je aanspreekt.
We screenen je CV en motivatiebrief. Bij een positieve screening volgt een HR-gesprek om je motivatie en match met NMBS te bespreken. We stellen ook enkele technische verkennende vragen.
Verloopt dit positief? Je ontvangt een technische opdracht die besproken wordt in een tweede gesprek. Ter voorbereiding op dit gesprek vragen we jou om een online persoonlijkheidsvragenlijst in te vullen.
Op basis van de volledige selectieprocedure kiezen we de best passende kandidaat. Daarna volgt een kennismaking met de Head of Corporate Strategy en de betrokken leidinggevende.
Verloopt deze laatste kennismaking goed? Er volgt dan een contractvoorstel.
Je bent klaar voor je eerste werkdag!


Wij behouden ons het recht om deze procedure aan te passen of op te schorten indien nodig. Ons rekruteringsteam zal de profielen selecteren die het best aansluiten bij de functie-eisen om een optimale match te garanderen.

Les statistiques

Driving progress through research. Providing material solutions for the world’s most pressing challenges and anticipating the needs of our customers requires a high level of investment in research. Umicore’s Group Research capabilities focus on new materials and processes to address the megatrends of resource scarcity and clean mobility. The nature of research and development means that we cannot stand still. We need to find new ways to do things, discover new solutions and develop new ideas. Which is where you come in.

Delivers expert work in General R, D & I with high quality and timeliness, applying best practices and standards.
Executes research projects within program, applying knowledge and expertise.- Builds knowledge and expertise within core competence subdomains.

Collaborates with adjacent teams and stakeholders, communicating insights and recommendations clearly.
Collaborates cross-functionally to deliver high-quality outcomes and knowledge sharing.
Contributes to continuous improvement by identifying and implementing process enhancements.

Education & Experience


Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related field
Minimum 3 years of experience developing industrial, agentic systems.
Demonstrated experience delivering at least one custom Generative AI application that goes significantly beyond basic document processing or retrieval
Experience working directly with business stakeholders and domain experts

Strong practical expertise in Generative AI and Large Language Model technologies.

Title: DATA SCIENTIST
Description:
At Ayesa Digital, we grow with you.




Every professional in our company is essential. Thanks to their talent, we continue to expand: today, we are a global team of more than 11,000 people working toward a shared mission.




Ayesa Digital is currently participating in high-impact European Union projects designed to address major European challenges and drive science and innovation. These strategic technological initiatives stand out for their international scope and strong commitment to socially oriented results.




We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our international team and contribute to collaborate with stakeholders to collect requirements, fram business problemas as data science hypotheses, define success metrics, and develop or deploy advanced data mining and machine learning solutions.




Key Responsibilities




Collaborate with User Experience (UX) and product teams to specify design requirements for the effective presentation and interpretation of model outputs and insights.
Develop process to monitor and analyse data accuracy.
Identify, collect, and prepare data for analysis, collaborating with Data Analysts to ensure robust production-grade data pipelines, with a focus on feature engineering and data readiness for modelling.
Produce data models according to specific problems statements.
Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, statistical models, and scripts to solve specific business problems.
Collaborate with Data Analysts and Architects on the design of the analytics architecture to ensure it supports the scalability and performance requirements of data science models.
Write the different documentation associated with the tasks and liaise with other teams as necessary to address cross-system interdependencies.
Developing visualizations to communicate model behaviour, key insights, and performance metrics, and collaborating with Data Analysts on integrated dashboard reporting.
Design, develop, and evaluate predictive models capable of handling both structured and unstructured data, including model selection, training, and hyperparameter tuning
Elaborate processes to ensure the compliant implementation of regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act), including model risk management, monitoring for drift/bias, and comprehensive documentation (e.g., model cards).
Ensure that model development, deployment, and monitoring practices adhere to all relevant regulatory frameworks and internal governance policies.
Communicate model insights, limitations, and behaviour effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences, and create interpretable outputs and documentation.
Conduct rigorous experiment design (e.g., A/B testing), employ cross-validation techniques, and perform statistical significance testing to validate findings and model performance.
Deploy and maintain models into production using Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) practices, including Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, model registries, and ensuring reproducibility.




What We Are Looking For (Requirements):




Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques and tools (e.g., Python, R, SAS, Spark) to design and implement data-driven solutions.
Knowledge of machine learning and natural language processing (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face) to build predictive and text-based models.
Knowledge of programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL; Perl optional) commonly used in data science for modelling and automation.
Knowledge of MLOps practices (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, model registry, unit testing frameworks) to ensure reproducibility and quality in model delivery.
Knowledge of business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, SAS, SAP Analytics) to visualise and communicate model outputs and insights.
Knowledge of data engineering and ETL processes using tools (e.g., Talend, Informatica, dbt, Azure Data Factory) to prepare training datasets.
Knowledge of data storage and query technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL, MongoDB, Hadoop) to extract and process data at scale.
Knowledge of designing scalable data storage solutions (e.g., data lakes, lakehouses, distributed stores) for advanced analytics and AI workloads.
Knowledge of advanced analytics applications such as forecasting, recommendation systems, anomaly detection, or sentiment analysis for business impact.
Knowledge of AI governance principles (e.g., transparency, explainability, fairness, accountability) aligned with emerging EU AI Act requirements.
Knowledge of AI compliance, risks, and mitigation practices (e.g., bias monitoring, drift detection, model cards).
Knowledge of data and AI regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, EU AI Act) and ability to design models compliant with legal and ethical standards.
Knowledge of experiment design (e.g., A/B testing, cross-validation, significance testing) to validate models rigorously.
Knowledge of model deployment practices (e.g., containerization, APIs, serving frameworks) to operationalise machine learning solutions.




One of the following or an equivalent certification:

AWS Certified Machine Learning.
Specialty or Azure AI Engineer Associate.




What We Offer:

Prestigious projects within European institutions.
International, innovative, and multicultural environments.
Continuous support from a team of experts in EU projects.




If you are ambitious, enthusiastic, and seeking a new professional challenge in international projects with real-world impact, this is the place for you!

Title: Applied Data Scientist
Description:
Company Overview

team.blue is the market leader in enabling digital success for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) across Europe, catering to over 3 million customers in 25+ languages. Our mission is to make online business success simpler, by providing our customers with all the tools and resources they need to excel online and remain ahead of the curve.

Position Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Applied Data Scientist who thrives at the intersection of AI, product thinking, and innovation. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing Data Science & ML algorithms to solve complex, real-world business problems across the team.blue group. This role requires strong analytical skills, programming, problem solving and data wrangling skills, good communication abilities, and up-to-date knowledge of the latest Data Science/ML/AI developments.

Responsibilities:


Break down multi-domain business problems with a strong focus on return on investment and impact metrics, and think through the appropriate technical methods from POC to production
Develop solutions and extract insight from data using data science and classical machine learning methods and generative AI (GenAI)
Take ownership of developing, implementing, and automating robust data science and ML models and pipelines, including feature generation, modeling, evaluation, retraining and deployment
Translate sophisticated analytical findings and model outcomes into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, demonstrably driving value and improvements in key business metrics
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver innovative Data Science/ML/AI solutions
Conduct research on the latest Data Science/ML/AI developments and apply them to improve our systems
Document processes, code, and findings for future reference and knowledge sharing



Required Skills:


8+ years hands-on industry experience solving data science and machine learning problems to address real-world business problems across multiple verticals
Expert programming skills in Python and SQL and with relevant Data Science & ML frameworks (Scikit-learn, Pandas, PyTorch, etc)
Ability to think through problems from fundamental principles and operate with a high degree of independence and autonomy while bringing clarity to under-specified problems
Deep understanding of statistical and ML algorithms, methodologies and approaches ranging from SVMs to deep learning & LLMs
Ability to own the end to end of the lifecycle of ML/AI projects from conception to containerization
History of hands-on ownership & implementer of projects that have been put in production and made an impact
Experience in applying statistical concepts (e.g. regressions, A/B tests, clustering, probability) to business problems
Strong problem-solving skills with excellent verbal & written communication and the ability to craft analysis into well-written and persuasive content
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams



Nice to have skills


Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, AI, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Machine Learning, or related fields.
Deep understanding of current DataOps & MLOps practices, deploying and monitoring models and ETL (extract, transform and load) pipelines
Experience with AI/ML R&D
Experience across startups and enterprise firms
Experience with distributed data tools (e.g. Spark, Dask, Apache Arrow), observability frameworks (OTel)

Everyone is welcome here. Diversity & Inclusion are at our core. Far above any technical competence, we value respect, openness, and trusted collaboration. We do not tolerate intolerance.

Title: Data Scientist (Space ISR & AI) for NATO with security clearance
Description:
Would you like to join the leading international intergovernmental organization?

This position supports the SHAPE J2 Capability Development (J2 CapDev) in collaboration with the NCIA CTO's Data & AI Center of Excellence (Data & AI CoE). The role is embedded within the AI Opportunities & Solutions Cell to advance space-based Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) workflows and Related Intelligence Capability Programme Plans (CPPs).

Responsibilities:

Geospatial and ISR data science:


Analyse near- and long-term AI opportunities with clear operational value for space-based ISR workflows.
Prepare and curate labelled datasets for assessments, demonstrations, and analysis initiatives.
Recommend methods to strengthen data collection and management to enhance space-based intelligence workflows
Conduct monthly training sessions to educate stakeholders and end users on AI and geospatial data science.
Provide technical/logistical assistance to showcase AI tools and progress during Demo Day or program demonstrations.
Evaluate analytics capabilities and recommend actionable reports for improvement.
Perform a review of emerging AI technologies and recommend applications for NATO's ISR capabilities.
Shared resource: SHAPE J2 Capability Development (J2 CapDev) and NCIA CTO's Data & Ai Center of Excellence (Data & Ai CoE).


Essential Qualifications & Experience:

Data Scientist for AI Opportunities & Solutions Cell for space based Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) and Related Intelligence Capability Programme Plans (CPPs).

Educational Background:


A nationally recognized or certified university degree in data science, mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, or a related field.
Exceptionally, candidates without a university degree may qualify if they possess significant expertise (minimum 3 years) relevant to the role and duties.


Experience:


3+ years working on AI for imagery or geospatial analysis in production or mission environments (industry, government, or defence).
Demonstrated expertise in artificial intelligence/machine learning workflows, including data labelling, preparation, and processing for large-scale imagery or geospatial datasets.
Experience developing and delivering training and demo materials to mixed technical/non-technical audiences.


Technical skills:


Python (NumPy, Pandas) and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
Data visualization tools/techniques.


Additional competencies:


Ability to lead ideation sessions, build rapid ML prototypes, and translate operational needs into measurable model/evaluation requirements.
Familiarity with Responsible AI principles.


Language Proficiency:


Fluent in Business English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.


Soft Skills:


Strong problem-solving abilities.
Excellent teamwork, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Experience interacting effectively with non-technical stakeholders.
High motivation with flexibility and adaptability to new challenges.
Creativity

Title: Job | GenAI - Data Scientist | Brussel
Description:
Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

AI- & ML-solution development


Machine learning- en deep learning-modellen (inclusief generative AI) inzetten om complexe bedrijfsproblemen op te lossen.
Modellen optimaliseren voor prestaties, schaalbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie in Azure-cloudomgevingen.
MLOps-pijplijnen implementeren om modeltraining, validatie en uitrol te automatiseren.



Cloud- & AI-infrastructuur


Schaalbare AI-infrastructuur ontwikkelen en onderhouden op Azure-cloudplatformen, gebruikmakend van diensten zoals Azure ML en AKS.
Zorgen voor veilige, conforme en hoog-beschikbare AI-implementaties in de cloud.



Generatieve AI & Innovatie


Generative AI-modellen (LLM’s, enz.) verkennen en integreren voor toepassingen zoals: RAG, intelligent document processing, speech-to-text en conversational AI.
Vooroplopen in AI-trends (bijv. fine-tuning, multimodal AI) en innovatieve use cases voorstellen.



Data- & modelgovernance


Zorgen voor datakwaliteit, bias-mitigatie en ethische AI-praktijken bij modelontwikkeling.
Modelmonitoring en explainability-tools implementeren om prestaties en compliance te volgen.



Samenwerking & stakeholder engagement


Samenwerken met productteams, data scientists en zakelijke stakeholders om AI-kansen te identificeren.
Zakelijke vereisten vertalen naar technische AI-oplossingen en inzichten effectief communiceren.



De job in een notendop

Je speelt een centrale rol in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van geavanceerde AI- en machine learning-oplossingen die innovatie en automatisering binnen de organisatie stimuleren.

Je werkt samen met cross-functionele teams om cloudgebaseerde AI-diensten, generatieve AI en schaalbare ML-infrastructuur te benutten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat AI-modellen robuust, ethisch verantwoord en afgestemd zijn op de bedrijfsdoelstellingen.

Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn

Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan als je iemand bent met:


Een master of doctoraat in de wetenschappen met uitstekende academische resultaten op technisch gebied (econometrie, computerwetenschappen, artificiële intelligentie, e.a.).
Deskundigheid op het vlak van
machine learning technieken en bereidheid om die kennis up-to-date te houden; een diepgaande kennis van algoritmes zoals Random Forests, Neural Networks en reinforcement learning is hierbij een must.
genAI: prompt engineering, structured outputs, ...(zie verantwoordelijkheden).

Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python en SQL.
Uitgebreide kennis van Nederlands of Frans, met passieve kennis van de andere taal, en Engels.
Ervaring in het verklaren van complexe analyses aan een niet-technisch publiek aan de hand van je verhalende competenties en je capaciteit om data te visualiseren; je beschikt over uitmuntende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden op technisch en businessniveau.
Honger naar kennis, niet alleen om nieuwe algoritmes en technologieën te beheersen, maar ook op interpersoonlijk vlak; je bent je ervan bewust dat de waarde van jouw werk neerkomt op kwaliteit x acceptatie en je wilt sleutelen aan beide aspecten.
Uitzonderlijke probleemoplossende vaardigheden: je weet dat het juiste inzicht in een probleem minstens 90% van de oplossing uitmaakt, je geeft blijk van creativiteit en volharding bij het doorgronden van problemen en het zoeken van oplossingen.


Je scoort extra met:


Tweetaligheid (Engels en Nederlands of Frans).
Ervaring met het bouwen van dataproducten, van ontwerp tot productie.
Wat full-stack skills.
Kennis van cloud, bij voorkeur Azure.



Belfius koestert zijn talenten

Behalve de kans om elke dag te shinen, bieden wij jou een fulltime contract van onbepaalde duur met:


Een mooi loon aangevuld met een innovatief aanbod om een persoonlijk budget samen te stellen dat je kan besteden volgens je voorkeuren (bv. wagen, fiets, pc, smartphone, tablet, huisvesting onder bepaalde voorwaarden) en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, personeelsvoordeel op eigen producten en diensten, en een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
Mogelijkheden te over om je te ontwikkelen door een brede waaier aan opleidingen en carrièrekansen in de hele Belfius-groep.
Een goede werk-privé balans dankzij flexibele uren, de combinatie kantoor- en thuiswerk en een aantrekkelijk aantal vakantiedagen.
Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Brussel met een coole fitness, een lekker gezond restaurant en gezellige ontmoetingsruimtes, dit alles op wandelafstand van de winkelstraat, het treinstation Brussel-Noord en de metrohalte Rogier.

Title: Data Scientist (Senior)
Description:
Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our Data & Analytics team. As a Data Scientist you will not only bring technical expertise but also a deep understanding of business operations and strategy. Your work will directly influence decision-making and help shape the future of our organization through actionable insights drawn from complex datasets.

As a Data Scientist, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business leaders, product managers, and engineers, to design and implement data-driven solutions that align with the company’s goals. You will be expected to translate complex data into business value, leveraging machine learning, predictive modeling, and statistical analysis.

Key Responsibilities:


Business Insight Development: Understand the key business challenges and opportunities, and use data to develop solutions that align with strategic objectives.
Data Strategy: Collaborate with leadership to define the data science roadmap and priorities based on business needs and opportunities.
Predictive Modeling & Machine Learning: Build, deploy, and maintain machine learning models to forecast trends, optimize processes, and drive business outcomes.
Data Analysis & Visualization: Analyze large, complex datasets to extract actionable insights, and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Data science pipeline: Advise, build and continuously improve the data science pipeline which best responds to team.blue analytics needs.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with business leaders, product teams, and engineers to ensure that data solutions meet business requirements.
Continuous Improvement: Stay up to date with the latest trends in data science, AI, and machine learning to continuously improve the team’s capabilities.



Requirements:


Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in data science, with a proven track record of solving complex business problems using data.
Strong understanding of business operations and the ability to align data science projects with business objectives.
Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical insights into business recommendations and communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
Problem-solving: Strong analytical thinking with the ability to handle complex and unstructured data.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, or Scala.
Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, Scikit-learn).
Experience with SQL and working with large data sets.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and big data tools (e.g., Hadoop, Spark).

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
As a Data Scientist, you will be part of a global team supporting the development and manufacturing of innovative biologic medicines. Leveraging advanced statistics and data science, you will help optimize processes, drive scientific decision-making, and generate actionable insights from complex datasets. You will collaborate closely with experts across Manufacturing, Process Development, and Analytical Sciences to support both operational excellence and innovation initiatives.



Key Responsibilities


Provide statistical and data science support for process optimization, validation, monitoring, and investigations.
Collect, structure, analyze, and interpret complex datasets to deliver meaningful business and scientific insights.
Design and execute experimental studies (DoE) to support data-driven decision-making.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for technical and cross-functional stakeholders.
Contribute to protocols, reports, and technical documentation with significant statistical content.
Act as a subject matter expert in statistics and data science, providing guidance across multiple functions.
Ensure data integrity, reliability, and compliance within a regulated environment.
Support digital transformation and advanced analytics initiatives across manufacturing operations.


Profile


Master's degree or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Biostatistics, or a related scientific discipline.
Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry.
Strong expertise in statistical methodologies and modern data science techniques.
Experience with biologics development, manufacturing processes, or process development is an asset.

Title: Job | GenAI - Data Scientist | Bruxelles
Description:
Description

Vous jouez un rôle central dans la conception, le développement et la mise en œuvre de solutions d’IA et d’apprentissage automatique avancées, favorisant l’innovation et l’automatisation au sein de l’organisation.

Vous collaborez avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour tirer parti des services d’IA dans le cloud, de l’IA générative et d’une infrastructure d’apprentissage automatique évolutive.

Vous veillez à ce que les modèles d’IA soient robustes, éthiques et alignés sur les objectifs commerciaux.

Votre job en deux mots

Principales responsabilités :

Développement de solutions d’IA et d’apprentissage automatique :

Déploiement de modèles d’apprentissage automatique et d’apprentissage profond (y compris l’IA générative) pour résoudre des problèmes métier complexes.

Optimisation des modèles en termes de performance, d’évolutivité et de rentabilité dans les environnements cloud Azure.

Mise en œuvre de pipelines MLOps pour automatiser l’entraînement, la validation et le déploiement des modèles.

Infrastructure cloud et d’IA :

Développement et maintenance d’une infrastructure d’IA évolutive sur les plateformes cloud Azure, en utilisant des services tels qu’Azure ML et AKS.

Garantie de déploiements d’IA sécurisés, conformes et hautement disponibles dans le cloud. IA générative et innovation.

Explorer et intégrer des modèles d'IA générative (LLM, etc.) pour des applications telles que : RAG (Real Agile Agile), traitement intelligent de documents, transcription vocale et IA conversationnelle.

Anticiper les tendances en IA (par exemple, le fine-tuning, l'IA multimodale) et proposer des cas d'usage innovants.

Gouvernance des données et des modèles

Garantir la qualité des données, la réduction des biais et le respect des pratiques éthiques en matière d'IA lors du développement des modèles.

Mettre en œuvre des outils de surveillance et d'explicabilité des modèles afin de suivre leurs performances et leur conformité.

Collaboration et mobilisation des parties prenantes

Collaborer avec les équipes produit, les data scientists et les parties prenantes métier pour identifier les opportunités offertes par l'IA.

Traduire les besoins métier en solutions techniques d'IA et communiquer efficacement les résultats obtenus.

Pas besoin d’être un oiseau rare

Mais vous pouvez en devenir un, parmi nous. Chez nous, vous pouvez vous distinguer et révéler le meilleur de vous-même si vous répondez aux critères suivants:


Un master ou un doctorat en sciences, avec d'excellents résultats académiques dans des domaines techniques (économétrie, informatique, intelligence artificielle, etc.).
Une expertise en
techniques d'apprentissage automatique et la volonté de maintenir vos connaissances à jour ; une connaissance approfondie d'algorithmes tels que les forêts
aléatoires, les réseaux de neurones et l'apprentissage par renforcement est indispensable.
GenAI : ingénierie rapide, résultats structurés, etc. (voir les responsabilités).
De solides compétences en programmation Python et SQL.
Une excellente maîtrise du néerlandais ou du français, avec des notions de l'autre langue, et de l'anglais.
Une expérience dans la vulgarisation d'analyses complexes auprès d'un public non technique, grâce à vos talents de conteur et votre capacité à visualiser les données. Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, tant sur le plan technique que commercial.
Une soif d'apprendre, non seulement pour maîtriser de nouveaux algorithmes et technologies, mais aussi sur le plan relationnel ; vous êtes conscient(e) que la valeur de votre travail repose sur la qualité et l'acceptation, et vous souhaitez travailler sur ces deux aspects.
Des compétences exceptionnelles en résolution de problèmes : vous savez qu'une bonne compréhension d'un problème représente au moins 90 % de la solution ; vous faites preuve de créativité et de persévérance pour comprendre les problèmes et trouver des solutions.


Un plus :


Bilinguisme (anglais et néerlandais ou français).
Expérience en développement de produits de données, de la conception à la production.
Compétences en développement full-stack.
Connaissance du cloud, de préférence Azure.



Belfius prend soin de ses talents

Outre la possibilité de faire votre chemin dans un job qui vous plaît, nous vous offrons un contrat à temps plein à durée indéterminée avec :


Un salaire attractif complété par une offre innovante vous octroyant un budget à utiliser selon vos préférences personnelles (p. ex. voiture, vélo, PC, smartphone, tablette, loyer ou crédit hypothécaire sous certaines conditions) et des avantages extralégaux, tels que des chèques-repas, des avantages sur les produits et services internes, une assurance hospitalisation et une assurance groupe.
Des possibilités de développement par le biais d'un large éventail de formations et des opportunités de carrière dans l’ensemble du groupe Belfius.
Un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à des horaires flexibles, à la combinaison du travail au bureau et à domicile et un nombre attractif de jours de congé.
Un lieu de travail moderne au cœur de Bruxelles, avec une salle de sport branchée, un délicieux restaurant sain et des espaces de réunion confortables, le tout à quelques pas de la rue commerciale, de la gare Bruxelles-Nord et de la station métro Rogier.

Bouwen en trainen van modellen (bv. met Python, PyTorch, LangChain, etc.)

Title: AI / ML Engineer - Operational Intelligence & Predictive Analytics
Description:
Accelerate the zero-carbon transition with AI

ENGIE Renewables & Batteries (R&B) BeNeLux is a key player in the energy transition, operating more than 2 GW of renewable and storage assets across wind, solar, hydro and batteries.

Our ambition is clear: grow to 3 GW by 2030.

To achieve this, we are scaling the use of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning across our operations — enabling smarter forecasting, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection and data-driven decision-making that enhance performance, safety and efficiency.

We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer to turn data into real operational impact.

YOUR CHALLENGE as AI/ML Engineer – Operational Intelligence & Predictive Analytics (M/F/X)

As an AI/ML Engineer, you are embedded within the business and work closely with operational teams across Renewables Operations.

You take end-to-end responsibility for AI-driven solutions — from ideation to deployment — and act as both a technical expert and a business partner to drive the adoption of AI across the organization.

In this role, you report directly to the Head of Operations, ensuring strong visibility at leadership level. You will initially have no direct reports, but will collaborate closely with multiple teams across the organization.

Your Key Responsibilities

AI & Data Solutions


Design, train and deploy machine learning models Build and maintain end-to-end data pipelines, from operational data sources to actionable insights
Integrate AI/ML models into tools, dashboards and operational workflows


Business Impact & Adoption


Translate operational and business needs into scalable AI use cases
Support and drive the adoption of AI solutions across teams (Development, Construction, Engineering, Admin Support, HSE, Finance & Controlling)
Act as AI/ML Subject Matter Expert within Renewables Operations


Ecosystem & Governance


Contribute to the development of ENGIE’s AI & data ecosystem
Ensure alignment with cybersecurity and data governance standards


YOUR PROFILE as AI/ML Engineer – Operational Intelligence & Predictive Analytics (M/F/X)


Engineering background with a strong interest in AI, or Master’s degree in AI, Data Science or equivalent experience
Proven experience in machine learning and Python
Solid knowledge of data processing & feature engineering (pandas, SQL)
Experience with time-series or industrial data (e.g. SCADA) is a strong asset
Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI) and cloud platforms
Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and ability to translate complex topics for non-technical stakeholders
Proactive, hands-on and results-driven team player, able to work autonomously in operational environments
English proficiency required; good knowledge of Dutch or French


Location & mobility


Brussels (base location)
Hybrid working model - Occasional travel within Belgium, the Netherlands and France


What We Offer


A key role with real impact in the energy transition and AI transformation
The opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI use cases in renewable operations
A dynamic, innovative and collaborative environment
Strong exposure across teams and business activities
Competitive salary package with attractive extra-legal benefits:

Tax-optimized bonus plan
Hospitalization & medical insurance
Retirement plan
Meal vouchers (€10 / €1.09 net contribution)
Electric company car with charging card (Belgium & neighbouring countries) or green alternative via mobility plan


Our hiring process

CV screening

HR interview (Teams)

Online assessments

Final interview with Hiring Manager

Professional

Job Description

Johnson & Johnson is seeking a Data Science & AI Automation Lead to join Healthcare Compliance (HCC) Global Operations as a senior individual contributor and technical expert located in Singapore; Beerse, Belgium; High Wycombe, United Kingdom; or New Brunswick, New Jersey, USA.

In this hands-on role, you will design and deliver AI-powered automation, advanced analytics, digital monitoring, and Copilot-enabled solutions that enhance compliance operations globally. Partnering closely with compliance, business, and technology teams, you will translate complex challenges into scalable, data-driven solutions that improve risk management, decision-making, operational efficiency, and user experience across multiple regions and markets.

Position Summary

The Data Science & AI Automation Lead is responsible for developing and scaling innovative analytics, automation, and AI solutions that strengthen Healthcare Compliance operations worldwide.

Acting as a technical lead, this role drives the adoption of advanced analytics, generative AI, Copilot agents, intelligent monitoring platforms, and Power Platform solutions to deliver actionable insights, streamline processes, and enable data-driven decision-making across HCC functions.

Key Responsibilities

AI & Copilot Solutions


Lead design and implementation of Microsoft Copilot, AI agents, and Generative AI solutions supporting Healthcare Compliance operations.
Develop and deploy Copilot Agents, policy assistants, chatbot solutions, and knowledge retrieval capabilities to improve user experience and productivity.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate business opportunities into scalable enterprise solutions.
Partner with governance, compliance, and technology teams to ensure responsible AI adoption and alignment with organisational standards.


Skills Required.


Strong experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, and Advanced Analytics to develop predictive, operational, and insight-driven solutions.
Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Data Engineering for data transformation, modelling, automation, and analytics development.
Strong proficiency in visualisation tools such as Power BI and Tableau to design interactive dashboards, self-service reporting tools, and stakeholder-ready business intelligence solutions.
Strong problem definition and design thinking skills to convert ambiguous business needs into user-centered, scalable analytics and automation solutions.
Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where business problems may not be clearly defined at the start; able to shape direction, ask the right questions, and create clarity with stakeholders.
Working knowledge of Power Platform and Power Automate is desirable, particularly for workflow automation and rapid prototyping, but secondary to core data science, AI, analytics, and integration capabilities.
Experience leveraging SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and enterprise collaboration technologies to deliver digital solutions and knowledge management capabilities.
Proven ability to design and implement API integrations and connected systems across multiple platforms and data sources.
Experience in process mining, workflow optimisation, and intelligent automation to improve operational efficiency.
Strong background in solution architecture, technical design, and scalable application development.
Demonstrated success delivering analytics products and business intelligence solutions from concept through deployment and adoption.
Excellent presentation, facilitation, and communication skills to drive discussions with business and technology teams, translate business context into technical requirements, and explain technical solutions in clear, practical language.
Knowledge of Cloud, AI, Generative AI, and Copilot technologies with the ability to translate emerging technologies into practical business solutions.


Stakeholder Management & Leadership


Act as a trusted technical advisor to global compliance leaders and business stakeholders.
Lead solution discussions, proof-of-concepts, demonstrations, and technology evaluations.
Translate business requirements into technical solutions and drive execution from concept through deployment.
Mentor team members and promote adoption of modern analytics and AI practices.

Title: AI / ML Engineer - Operational Intelligence & Predictive Analytics

Accelerate the zero-carbon transition with AI

ENGIE Renewables & Batteries (R&B) BeNeLux is a key player in the energy transition, operating more than 2 GW of renewable and storage assets across wind, solar, hydro and batteries.

Our ambition is clear: grow to 3 GW by 2030.

To achieve this, we are scaling the use of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning across our operations — enabling smarter forecasting, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection and data-driven decision-making that enhance performance, safety and efficiency.

We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer to turn data into real operational impact.

YOUR CHALLENGE as AI/ML Engineer – Operational Intelligence & Predictive Analytics (M/F/X)

As an AI/ML Engineer, you are embedded within the business and work closely with operational teams across Renewables Operations.

You take end-to-end responsibility for AI-driven solutions — from ideation to deployment — and act as both a technical expert and a business partner to drive the adoption of AI across the organization.

In this role, you report directly to the Head of Operations, ensuring strong visibility at leadership level. You will initially have no direct reports, but will collaborate closely with multiple teams across the organization.

Your Key Responsibilities

AI & Data Solutions


Design, train and deploy machine learning models Build and maintain end-to-end data pipelines, from operational data sources to actionable insights
Integrate AI/ML models into tools, dashboards and operational workflows


Business Impact & Adoption


Translate operational and business needs into scalable AI use cases
Support and drive the adoption of AI solutions across teams (Development, Construction, Engineering, Admin Support, HSE, Finance & Controlling)
Act as AI/ML Subject Matter Expert within Renewables Operations


Ecosystem & Governance


Contribute to the development of ENGIE’s AI & data ecosystem
Ensure alignment with cybersecurity and data governance standards


YOUR PROFILE as AI/ML Engineer – Operational Intelligence & Predictive Analytics (M/F/X)


Engineering background with a strong interest in AI, or Master’s degree in AI, Data Science or equivalent experience
Proven experience in machine learning and Python
Solid knowledge of data processing & feature engineering (pandas, SQL)
Experience with time-series or industrial data (e.g. SCADA) is a strong asset
Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI) and cloud platforms
Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and ability to translate complex topics for non-technical stakeholders
Proactive, hands-on and results-driven team player, able to work autonomously in operational environments
English proficiency required; good knowledge of Dutch or French


Location & mobility


Brussels (base location)
Hybrid working model - Occasional travel within Belgium, the Netherlands and France


What We Offer


A key role with real impact in the energy transition and AI transformation
The opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI use cases in renewable operations
A dynamic, innovative and collaborative environment
Strong exposure across teams and business activities
Competitive salary package with attractive extra-legal benefits:

Tax-optimized bonus plan
Hospitalization & medical insurance
Retirement plan
Meal vouchers (€10 / €1.09 net contribution)
Electric company car with charging card (Belgium & neighbouring countries) or green alternative via mobility plan


Our hiring process

CV screening

HR interview (Teams)

Online assessments

Final interview with Hiring Manager
